<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Signup" name="Subscription signup"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Updates" name="Subscription updates, enhancements, or renewal notifications"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subscription">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SubscriptionService" name="Subscription service" processRef="Process_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Signup" name="Sign up" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Cancellation" name="Submit cancellation request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="CatchEvent_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Send subscription notifications" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Updates"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Signup" name="Customer signs up and enters personal and payment information">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Signup_GenerateAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Signup_GenerateAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateAccount_AssignAccess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateAccount_AssignAccess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssignAccess_Billing</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssignAccess_Billing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Billing_Updates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates, product enhancements, or renewal notifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Billing_Updates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_Cancellation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_Cancellation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancellation_Process</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Support team processes cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancellation_Process</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessCancellation_ApplyTerms</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyTerms" name="Apply any refunds or charges according to the terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessCancellation_ApplyTerms</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApplyTerms_Deactivate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Deactivate" name="Support team deactivates subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApplyTerms_Deactivate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deactivate_Settle</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deactivate_Settle</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Settle_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubscriptionConcluded" name="Subscription deactivated and final account balance settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Settle_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signup_GenerateAccount" sourceRef="StartEvent_Signup" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateAccount_AssignAccess" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignAccess_Billing" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Billing_Updates" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Cancellation" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="CatchEvent_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancellation_Process" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Cancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessCancellation_ApplyTerms" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Task_ApplyTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplyTerms_Deactivate" sourceRef="Task_ApplyTerms" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deactivate_Settle" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Settle_End" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_SubscriptionConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
